name: Lijiang
summary: An ancient city beneath snow-capped peaks — where time slows and softness finds you

highlights.name: Lijiang Old Town
highlights.desc: A UNESCO World Heritage site and the cultural heart of the Naxi people, with cobblestone lanes, arched bridges, and flowing streams.

highlights.name: Yulong Snow Mountain
highlights.desc: The southernmost snow peak in the Northern Hemisphere, offering breathtaking glacier views.

highlights.name: Shuhe Ancient Town
highlights.desc: A quieter alternative to Dayan Old Town — a favorite among artists and wanderers.

highlights.name: Lashi Sea
highlights.desc: A highland wetland nature reserve, perfect for horseback riding and boat rides.

content:
Lijiang lies in northwestern Yunnan Province, a historic key stop along the ancient Tea Horse Road. Here you'll find a perfectly preserved Naxi ancient town, the sacred grandeur of Yulong Snow Mountain, and the serene charm of Shuhe Ancient Town.

Lijiang is languid at dawn, languid in the afternoon, and languid at night. Find a traditional inn, soak up the sunshine, cuddle a cat, and gaze at the snow peaks — let the hours drift by.

Recommended: Browse the night market at Sifang Square, watch the snow mountain reflected in Black Dragon Pool, ride horses at Lashi Sea, and while away the hours in Shuhe Ancient Town.

name: Dali
summary: Land of wind, flowers, snow and moon — poetry and the horizon set between Cangshan and Erhai

highlights.name: Dali Old Town
highlights.desc: The former capital of the Nanzhao Kingdom — today a vibrant gathering place for artists and free spirits.

highlights.name: Erhai Lake
highlights.desc: Yunnan's second-largest highland lake, ideal for scenic cycling loops around its shores.

highlights.name: Cangshan Mountain
highlights.desc: Take the cable car to the summit for a sweeping panorama of Erhai Lake below.

highlights.name: Xizhou Ancient Town
highlights.desc: The best-preserved Bai ethnic town in the region.

content:
Dali sits in central Yunnan, the capital of the Bai Autonomous Prefecture. Wind, flowers, snow, moon — these four wonders are the very essence of Dali: the wind at Xiaguan Pass, the blossoms at Shangguan, the snow on Cangshan, and the moon over Erhai Lake.

Dali Old Town dates back over 600 years, preserving a remarkable collection of Ming and Qing dynasty architecture. Renting an electric bike for a full loop of Erhai Lake is the very best way to experience Dali.

name: Jiuzhaigou
summary: An earthly paradise on earth — where water blooms in impossible colors

highlights.name: Wuhua Hai (Five-Flower Lake)
highlights.desc: Jiuzhaigou's most stunning lake — its colors shift like a fairy tale come to life.

highlights.name: Nuorilang Waterfall
highlights.desc: One of China's widest high-altitude waterfalls.

highlights.name: Changhai (Long Lake)
highlights.desc: The largest and deepest lake in the entire Jiuzhaigou valley.

highlights.name: Tree-Zheng Lake Group
highlights.desc: Over 40 interconnected highland lakes strung together in a chain.

content:
Jiuzhaigou is located in the Aba Tibetan and Qiang Autonomous Prefecture of Sichuan Province. Its name comes from the nine Tibetan villages scattered throughout the valley, which was inscribed on the UNESCO World Natural Heritage List in 1992.

Within the valley are 108 highland lakes (called "haizi") whose waters display astonishing shades of turquoise and emerald — earning this place its reputation as an earthly paradise and a fairy-tale world.

name: Guilin
summary: The landscape of Guilin surpasses all under heaven — a Li River painting come to life

highlights.name: Li River
highlights.desc: Glide along on a bamboo raft past the very scene printed on the 20-yuan banknote.

highlights.name: Yangshuo West Street
highlights.desc: A lively blend of Chinese and Western culture — a street with true exotic flair.

highlights.name: Elephant Trunk Hill
highlights.desc: Guilin's iconic landmark — an elephant drinking from the river, carved by nature.

highlights.name: Longsheng Rice Terraces
highlights.desc: Magnificent terraced fields cascading down the mountainside.

content:
Guilin lies in northeast Guangxi, world-renowned for the famous saying "The scenery of Guilin surpasses all under heaven." Its karst landscape has sculpted a world of towering peaks and winding rivers.

Drifting downstream on a bamboo raft along the Li River, the green mountains on both banks mirrored in the water — you'll feel as though you are traveling inside a painting.

name: Lhasa, Tibet
summary: The closest place to the sky — a sacred city on the snow plateau

highlights.name: Potala Palace
highlights.desc: A palace perched on the world's roof — the most sacred site in Tibetan Buddhism.

highlights.name: Jokhang Temple
highlights.desc: The central spiritual destination for Tibetan Buddhist pilgrims.

highlights.name: Barkhor Street
highlights.desc: Lhasa's oldest and most atmospheric commercial street.

highlights.name: Namtso Lake
highlights.desc: Tibet's second-largest lake — a luminous blue sacred lake.

content:
Lhasa is the capital of the Tibet Autonomous Prefecture, sitting at 3,650 meters above sea level and known as the "City of Sunshine." The Potala Palace, Jokhang Temple, and Norbulingka together form Lhasa's three great landmarks.

This is a land closest to the sky: snow-capped mountains, sacred lakes, ancient temples, white stupas, and Tibetan villagers — together they compose a picture of profound mystery.

name: Qinghai Lake
summary: Jewel of the highland — intoxicating rapeseed blooms in July

highlights.name: Qinghai Lake
highlights.desc: China's largest inland saltwater lake.

highlights.name: Chaka Salt Lake
highlights.desc: The Mirror of the Sky — reflections so perfect they seem to blur the line between reality and illusion.

highlights.name: Bird Island
highlights.desc: A major breeding ground for migratory birds.

highlights.name: Erlangjian
highlights.desc: The most scenic stretch of the lakeshore — once a secret military site.

content:
Qinghai Lake sits on the northeastern edge of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau — China's largest saltwater lake. Its vast, boundless waters glow a blue that steals your breath away.

Every July and August, tens of thousands of acres of rapeseed flowers along the shore burst into golden bloom — golden flowers and blue lake water create a scene of breathtaking harmony.

name: Zhangjiajie
summary: Where Avatar found its floating mountains — a real-life Pandora

highlights.name: Tianmen Mountain
highlights.desc: 999 steps to heaven, plus the famous glass skywalk.

highlights.name: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park
highlights.desc: The real-life inspiration for the floating mountains of Avatar.

highlights.name: Yellow Dragon Cave
highlights.desc: One of the largest karst cave systems in Asia.

highlights.name: Fenghuang Ancient Town
highlights.desc: The riverside town made immortal in Shen Congwen's classic novel.

content:
Zhangjiajie lies in northwestern Hunan Province, celebrated for its one-of-a-kind quartz sandstone pillar-forest canyon landscape. The floating mountains in the film Avatar were directly inspired by the peaks of Zhangjiajie.

Here you'll find the world's longest passenger cable car, the most thrilling glass skywalk, and the most spectacular canyon scenery on earth.

name: Sanya
summary: The Hawaii of the East — a tropical paradise of coconut breezes and azure seas

highlights.name: Yalong Bay
highlights.desc: One of China's most beautiful bays.

highlights.name: Wuzhizhou Island
highlights.desc: China's premier diving destination.

highlights.name: Tianya Haijiao
highlights.desc: The classic must-see landmark — the 'end of the earth, the edge of the sea'.

highlights.name: Nanshan Cultural Tourism Zone
highlights.desc: Home to a 108-meter-tall Guanyin statue standing tall above the sea.

content:
Sanya occupies the southernmost tip of Hainan Island — China's most beloved tropical beach resort destination. Here you'll find azure seas, immaculate white-sand beaches, and graceful rows of coconut palms.

Whether it is a honeymoon, a family vacation, or simply a chance to unwind, Sanya is always the perfect choice.
